Option Explicit

' Run this macro from the document being rendered. It does not install itself
' in Normal.dotm and it does not alter a heading or a TOC field code.
Public Sub UpdateTocWithAppendixPrefix()
    Const AppendixCodePoint As Long = &H4ED8

    Dim doc As Document
    Dim toc As TableOfContents
    Dim appendixToc As TableOfContents

    Set doc = ActiveDocument

    For Each toc In doc.TablesOfContents
        If TocTargetsAppendix(toc) Then
            If Not appendixToc Is Nothing Then
                Err.Raise vbObjectError + 2101, , _
                    "More than one TOC field targets AUTO_APPENDIX."
            End If
            Set appendixToc = toc
        End If
    Next toc

    If appendixToc Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 2102, , _
            "No TOC field targeting AUTO_APPENDIX was found."
    End If

    If Not doc.Bookmarks.Exists("AUTO_APPENDIX") Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 2104, , "AUTO_APPENDIX bookmark is missing."
    End If

    ' A previous run locks the cached appendix results so Word's print path
    ' cannot recalculate them. Unlock before refreshing the native TOCs.
    For Each toc In doc.TablesOfContents
        If TocTargetsAppendix(toc) Then SetTocFieldsLocked toc, False
    Next toc

    ' Refresh both native TOCs before changing any result text.
    For Each toc In doc.TablesOfContents
        toc.Update
    Next toc

    doc.Repaginate
    PrefixPageResults appendixToc, ChrW(AppendixCodePoint)
    NormalizeAppendixFooter doc, ChrW(AppendixCodePoint)
    SetTocFieldsLocked appendixToc, True
End Sub

Private Function TocTargetsAppendix(ByVal toc As TableOfContents) As Boolean
    Dim code As String
    Dim tokens() As String
    Dim i As Long
    If toc.Range.Fields.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
    code = toc.Range.Fields.Item(1).Code.Text
    code = Replace(Replace(Replace(code, Chr$(34), ""), vbTab, " "), vbCr, " ")
    tokens = Split(code, " ")
    For i = 0 To UBound(tokens) - 1
        If LCase$(tokens(i)) = "\b" Then
            Do While i < UBound(tokens) - 1 And tokens(i + 1) = ""
                i = i + 1
            Loop
            TocTargetsAppendix = StrComp(tokens(i + 1), "AUTO_APPENDIX", vbTextCompare) = 0
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function

Private Sub PrefixPageResults(ByVal toc As TableOfContents, ByVal prefix As String)
    Dim field As Field
    Dim result As Range
    Dim pageText As String
    Dim found As Long
    Dim changed As Long

    ' Enumerate fields on the whole TOC range. The first paragraph also owns
    ' the outer TOC field; iterating paragraph fields would duplicate entries.
    For Each field In toc.Range.Fields
        If field.Type = wdFieldPageRef Then
            field.Locked = False
            field.Update
        End If
    Next field

    For Each field In toc.Range.Fields
        If InStr(1, field.Code.Text, "PAGEREF", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            found = found + 1
            Set result = field.Result.Duplicate
            pageText = result.Text
            pageText = Replace(pageText, vbCr, "")
            pageText = Replace(pageText, Chr$(7), "")
            pageText = Trim$(pageText)

            ' The test makes the operation idempotent if the macro is run twice.
            If Left$(pageText, Len(prefix)) <> prefix Then
                result.InsertBefore prefix
                changed = changed + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next field

    If found = 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 2103, , _
            "The appendix TOC contained no PAGEREF entries."
    End If

    MsgBox CStr(found) & " appendix TOC entries checked; " & _
        CStr(changed) & " prefixed.", vbInformation, "TOC update"
End Sub

Private Sub SetTocFieldsLocked(ByVal toc As TableOfContents, ByVal locked As Boolean)
    Dim field As Field
    For Each field In toc.Range.Fields
        field.Locked = locked
    Next field
End Sub

Private Sub NormalizeAppendixFooter(ByVal doc As Document, ByVal prefix As String)
    Dim sec As Section
    Dim footer As HeaderFooter
    Dim field As Field
    Dim ch As Range
    Dim fieldStart As Long
    Dim prefixEnd As Long
    Dim gap As Range
    Dim i As Long

    For Each sec In doc.Sections
        For Each footer In sec.Footers
            If footer.Exists Then
                For Each field In footer.Range.Fields
                    If field.Type = wdFieldPage Then
                        fieldStart = field.Code.Start
                        prefixEnd = -1
                        For Each ch In footer.Range.Characters
                            If ch.End <= fieldStart And ch.Text = prefix Then
                                prefixEnd = ch.End
                            End If
                        Next ch
                        If prefixEnd >= 0 Then
                            For i = footer.Range.Characters.Count To 1 Step -1
                                Set ch = footer.Range.Characters(i)
                                If ch.Start >= prefixEnd And ch.End <= fieldStart Then
                                    If Len(ch.Text) > 0 Then
                                        If AscW(ch.Text) = 32 Or AscW(ch.Text) = 12288 Then
                                            Set gap = ch.Duplicate
                                            gap.Delete
                                        End If
                                    End If
                                End If
                            Next i
                        End If
                    End If
                Next field
            End If
        Next footer
    Next sec
End Sub

# Word目次の更新

本文と付録は、それぞれの見出しから作るWord自動目次です。本文は1,2,3、付録は付1,付2,付3にします。

WordでVBAを使う場合は、UpdateTocWithAppendixPrefix.basの内容を標準モジュールへ貼り付け、対象文書をアクティブにしてUpdateTocWithAppendixPrefixを実行します。本文から目次を再生成した後、AUTO_APPENDIXを対象とする付録目次のPAGEREF結果だけに「付」を補い、付録目次のフィールドをロックします。次回は同じマクロで解除・更新・補正・再ロックします。Wordの通常更新だけでは補正を維持できません。

マクロは自動実行・自動登録されません。Normal.dotmの変更、文書のdocm化、VBAプロジェクトへの信頼設定の変更は行いません。BASはASCIIなのでインポート時の文字コード差を避けられます。「付」はChrWで生成します。

自動PDF出力では、同じprofileから取り出したInvoke-TocAppendixPrefixOnDocument.ps1をrender_publication_word.ps1の-TocHelperPathへ渡します。本文から目次を更新した後とPDF出力の直前に補正します。DOCXに結び付いたhelperのSHA256を確認してから読み込みます。VBAを注入・実行する経路ではありません。

対象の目次やブックマークが欠ける場合、複数ある場合、PAGEREFがない場合は失敗として扱います。付録の見出し本文や本文側の頁番号は変更しません。付録フッターのPAGE直前にある「付」と頁番号の間の空白だけを除去します。更新後は付録の先頭・末尾、頁数が変わった項目、二重接頭辞や欠け、PDF出力後も表示が維持されることを確認してください。
